name: Research Kit
description: A Flow Kit for source-traced research workflows. Provides three flows covering the full capture-to-recall cycle: ingest a source with provenance (capture), compile captured sources into a gated insight note (compile), and query prior knowledge with provenance-verified results (recall).

flows.description: Ingest a source (transcript, article, URL) with provenance. Gate: source ref + classification recorded before advancing.
Compile captured sources into an insight note. Gate: provenance links to every contributing source must be recorded.
Query prior captured and compiled knowledge. Gate: every result must carry provenance back to its originating source.

docs.description: Research Kit overview, flow descriptions, Knowledge Kit substrate relationship, and authoring notes.
Agent skill guidance for the capture flow: how to extract source refs, choose classification categories, and record provenance.
Agent skill guidance for the compile flow: how to select sources, draft insight notes, and link provenance.
Agent skill guidance for the recall flow: how to form queries and verify provenance on results.

skills.description: Guidance for executing the capture flow: source ingestion, provenance extraction, and classification.
Guidance for executing the compile flow: source selection, insight drafting, and provenance linking.
Guidance for executing the recall flow: query formation and provenance verification.
